operations.label: Fill ADFS password (ADFS branch only)
operations.summary: "Password" textbox on the ADFS sign-in page.
operations.note: Primary is input[name="Password"]; fallbacks are #passwordInput and getByRole(textbox, {name: /^password$/i}).

operations.label: ADFS — Password input (read)
operations.summary: "Password" textbox on the ADFS sign-in page.
operations.note: Primary is input[name="Password"]; fallbacks are #passwordInput and getByRole(textbox, {name: /^password$/i}).

operations.label: Click ADFS Sign In button (ADFS branch only)
operations.summary: "Sign in" submit button on the ADFS sign-in page.
operations.note: Primary is #submitButton; fallback is getByRole(button, {name: /^sign in$/i}).

operations.label: Fill ADFS username (ADFS branch only)
operations.summary: "User Account" textbox on the UCSD ADFS sign-in page.
operations.note: Only refilled if the field is currently empty — Microsoft usually pre-populates via ?username= URL param from AAD redirect

operations.label: ADFS — User Account input (read)
operations.summary: "User Account" textbox on the UCSD ADFS sign-in page.
operations.note: Primary is input[name="UserName"]; fallbacks are #userNameInput and getByRole(textbox, {name: /User Account/i}).

operations.label: Wait for DOM content loaded after KMSI dismiss
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded', timeout: 10s) — in dismissStaySignedIn, conditional on KMSI button having been present

operations.label: Wait for DOM content loaded after Microsoft Next
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded', timeout: 10s) — in handleMicrosoftEmailStep, conditional on email step having run

operations.label: Assert download was captured (not closed, not timed out)
operations.summary: Throws 'Browser window was closed before the download completed' if race result==='closed'; throws 'No download captured within Xs' if result===null

operations.label: Race: capture download event vs browser close vs timeout
operations.summary: Promise.race([page.once('download'), page.once('close') / context.once('close'), setTimeout(downloadTimeoutSeconds * 1000)]). Default timeout: 300s (5 min).

operations.label: Duo MFA approval gate
operations.summary: requestDuoApproval (kernel path — requires instance, surfaces Duo chip in Sessions rail) or pollDuoApproval (CLI/standalone path); systemLabel='SharePoint'; successUrlMatch includes sharepoint.com|office.com|kmsi|login.srf; timeout: 180s. Throws if approval times out.
operations.note: Conditional — skipped when page.url() already matches a success URL (warm-cookie fast-path)

operations.label: Click File button in Excel ribbon (WacFrame_Excel_0 iframe)
operations.summary: File button on the Excel Online ribbon (opens the backstage menu).
operations.note: All three menu ops (fileButton, createACopy, downloadACopy) are scoped to the WAC iframe via getExcelFrame(page). If fileButton count === 0, clickExcelDownloadMenu returns false and falls back to manual-download waiting prompt.

operations.label: Hover 'Create a Copy' to reveal the download flyout
operations.summary: "Create a Copy" menuitem in the File backstage.
operations.note: MUST use .hover(), not .click() — clicking fires the default 'Create a copy online' action which navigates away from the file. Returns false if not found.

operations.label: Click 'Download a Copy' in the Create a Copy flyout
operations.summary: "Download a Copy" menuitem in the Create a Copy flyout — fires the browser download event for xlsx.
operations.note: Returns false if not found. Click triggers the browser's native download event.

operations.label: Excel Online — WAC iframe frame locator
operations.summary: Returns the Excel Online FrameLocator scoping iframe[name="WacFrame_Excel_0"] on doc2.aspx.
operations.note: Frame-scoping utility — not a clickable/fillable target itself. Role inferred as read-only container. Every post-auth Excel interaction (ribbon, file menu, workbook body) MUST go through this FrameLocator or selectors resolve to nothing.

operations.label: Dismiss 'Stay signed in?' prompt (No)
operations.summary: "No" button on the "Stay signed in?" / KMSI prompt (login.srf).
operations.note: Conditional — skipped if kmsi.noButton count === 0; failure swallowed (prompt may auto-dismiss)

operations.label: Navigate to SharePoint file URL
operations.summary: page.goto(landingUrl, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30s }). URL read from pendingLandingUrl module-level slot set by the handler serial queue before each run.

operations.label: Fill Microsoft AAD email address
operations.summary: Email textbox on the Microsoft sign-in page.
operations.note: Conditional — skipped if microsoft.emailInput count === 0 (cached AAD session)

operations.label: Microsoft sign-in — email input (read)
operations.summary: Email textbox on the Microsoft sign-in page.
operations.note: Primary selector is CSS-based (input[type="email"] / input[name="loginfmt"]) because accessible name varies by tenant; .or() fallback chain used.

operations.label: Click Microsoft AAD Next button
operations.summary: "Next" button on the Microsoft email step.
operations.note: Only fires when emailInput was present; triggers AAD redirect chain to ADFS or Shibboleth

operations.label: Wait for network idle before KMSI prompt probe
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', timeout: 15s)

operations.label: Wait for Excel Online viewer to settle (network idle)
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', timeout: 30s)

operations.label: Assert page is on SharePoint or Office URL
operations.summary: Reads page.url(); throws 'Expected SharePoint/Office URL after login, got: ...' if it does not include sharepoint.com or office.com

operations.label: Save downloaded file to outDir, derive filename, update tracker row
operations.summary: Filename: if input.filenameBase set → '<filenameBase>-<YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS><ext>'; else '<YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS>-<sharepoint-suggested>'. download.saveAs(outPath). ctx.updateData({ filename, path: saved }) populates 'File' and 'Saved to' detailFields. Sets module-level lastDownloadResult for HTTP handler via _takeLastDownloadResult().

operations.label: Wait for SSO redirect chain to settle
operations.summary: page.waitForURL matching a5.ucsd.edu | ad-wfs-aws.ucsd.edu | /adfs/ls | duosecurity.com | sharepoint.com | office.com | login.microsoftonline.com/kmsi | .../login.srf, timeout: 30s

operations.label: Assert final URL is a SharePoint / Office success URL
operations.summary: Throws 'SharePoint authentication did not reach a success URL — final URL: ...' if page.url() does not include sharepoint.com | office.com | login.microsoftonline.com/kmsi | .../login.srf

operations.label: Wait 1s for File menu to open
operations.summary: page.waitForTimeout(1000)

operations.label: Wait 2s for WAC iframe JS to hydrate after networkidle
operations.summary: page.waitForTimeout(2000)

operations.label: Wait 3s for AAD redirect chain to start
operations.summary: page.waitForTimeout(3000)

operations.label: Wait 800ms for download flyout to appear after hover
operations.summary: page.waitForTimeout(800)
